description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development within a supportive environment. We are looking to fill this role quickly with a passionate leader.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and maintaining regulatory compliance. This position requires a strong leader with a commitment to excellence and a desire to foster a positive and productive work environment for all nursing staff.
requirements: Proven experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a DON or ADON
Experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range is $85,000 - $95,000, based on experience and qualifications.
